reason: Collabstr already does this for me, and I'd have to start over with a brand-new marketplace that has no track record. The escrow and draft approval are nice, but they don't give me a reason to switch this week.
objection: Follower counts and results are self-reported. That's exactly how I got burned before. A creator with padded numbers and a nice package page can still post something off-brand or flake.
would_change_my_mind: Follower counts and past results verified straight from Instagram/TikTok, so I know the creator's numbers and track record are real before I put money in.
